[Col. 0526A] Look upon me and have mercy on me, and grant me, who ask, an inward confession of heart, a fountain of tears, and remission of all sins.

Renew, make new [Cod. Reg.: “renew in me”], most loving Father, whatever has been corrupted by action, by word, and finally by thought through diabolical deceit; join me, a member of the unity of the Church’s body, to your redemption; and admit me, who have confidence in nothing except your mercy, to the sacrament of your reconciliation. Through Jesus Christ, your only-begotten Son, our Lord and Savior, who with you and the Holy Spirit is one Lord, reigning through immortal ages of ages. Amen.

[Note: [Col. 0525D] In Cod. Reg. the title is: “Here begin the seven penitential psalms, which every soul that desires to please God ought to sing for the remission of its sins.”] THE PENITENTIAL PSALMS [Note: [Col. 0526D] They appear in the booklet of Charles the Bald, p. 16 and following, without the prayers.]

## PSALM I

[Col. 0526B]

(PSALM 6.) Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger, nor chastise me in your wrath. Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak; heal me, Lord, for my bones are troubled. My soul too is greatly troubled; but you, Lord—how long? Turn, Lord, and rescue my soul; save me for the sake of your mercy. For in death no one remembers you; but in the underworld, who will confess you? I have labored in my groaning; every night I shall wash my bed; I shall water my couch with my tears. My eye is troubled by anger; I have grown old among all my enemies. Depart from me, all you who work iniquity, for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping. The Lord has heard my supplication; the Lord has received my prayer. [Col. 0526C] Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled; let them turn back and be speedily put to shame.

As above. Lord, turn and rescue my soul; save me for the sake of your mercy. Look upon me and hear me, Lord my God; enlighten my eyes, lest I ever sleep in death, lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him.” Cleanse me from my hidden faults, Lord, and spare your servant from those of others.

**Prayer.** God who hears all things, hear the pleading voice of our tears and grant lasting strength to our weaknesses [Cod. Reg.: “lasting health”], so that, while you graciously receive the groaning of our labor, your mercy may always console us. Through the Lord.

## PSALM II

(PSALM 31.) Blessed are those whose iniquities are forgiven and whose sins are covered. Blessed is the man to whom the Lord has not imputed sin and in whose spirit there is no deceit. For while I was silent, my bones grew old as I cried out all day. For day and night your hand lay heavily upon me; I was turned into misery while the thorn was fixed in me. I made my sin known to you, and I did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my iniquity against myself to the Lord”; and you forgave the wickedness of my sin. For this every holy person will pray to you at a suitable time. Yet in the flood of many waters they will not come near him. You are my refuge from the tribulation that surrounded me; my joy, rescue me from those who surround me. I will give you understanding and instruct you in this way, in which you will walk; I will fix my eyes upon you. Do not become like a horse or a mule, which have no understanding. With bit and bridle restrain their jaws, for they do not come near you. Many are the scourges of the sinner; but mercy will surround the one who hopes in the Lord. Rejoice in the Lord and exult, you righteous [Quercet.: “unrighteous,” erroneously]; and glory, all you upright of heart.

[Col. 0527B] As above. Do not remember, Lord, the sins of my youth and my ignorances. According to your great mercy, remember me, because of your goodness, Lord. For the sake of your name, Lord, you will be merciful toward my sin, for it is great. I made my sin known to you, and I did not hide my iniquity.

**Prayer.** Holy Lord, who attribute blessedness to those who confess to you when their offenses have been forgiven, hear the vows of this present household [Alt.: “Church”], and, when the goads of sin have been broken, pour over us spiritual exultation. Through our Lord.

## PSALM III

(PSALM 37.) Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger, nor chastise me in your wrath. For your arrows have been driven into me [Col. 0527C], and you have strengthened your hand against me. There is no health in my flesh because of your anger; there is no peace in my bones because of my sins. For my iniquities have risen above my head, and like a heavy burden they have weighed heavily upon me. My wounds have become foul and corrupt because of my foolishness. I have become wretched and bowed down utterly; all day I went about mourning. For my loins are filled with delusions, and there is no health in my flesh. I am afflicted and greatly humbled; I roared because of the groaning of my heart.

Lord, all my desire is before you, and my groaning is not hidden from you. My heart is troubled; my strength has abandoned me, and the light of my eyes itself is not with me. My friends [Col. 0527D] and my neighbors have drawn near and stood against me. Those who were near me stood far away, and those who sought my life used force against me. Those who sought evil for me spoke empty things and meditated on deceits all day. But I, like a deaf man, did not hear, and like a mute who does not open his mouth. I became like a man who does not hear [and] who has no reproofs in his mouth. For in you, Lord, I have hoped; you will hear me, Lord my God. For I said, “Let my enemies never rejoice over me”; and when my feet were shaken, they spoke great things against me.

For I am ready for scourges, and my pain is always before me. For I will announce my iniquity and think upon my sin. But my enemies live and have grown strong against me; those who hate me unjustly have multiplied. Those who repay evil for good slandered me, because I pursued goodness. Do not abandon me, Lord my God; do not depart from me. Attend to my help, Lord, God of my salvation.

**Prayers as above.** Lord, all my desire is before you, and my groaning is not hidden from you. Hear my prayer, Lord, and my supplication; listen with your ears to my tears. May it please you, Lord, to rescue me; Lord, look upon me to help me.

**Prayer.** Send forth your salvation upon our weaknesses, Lord, most powerful healer of mortal wounds and scars [Col. 0528B], so that, lamenting all our groaning and pain before you, we may prevail over the assaults of hostile vices. Through our Lord.

## PSALM IV

(PSALM 50.) Have mercy on me, God, according to your great mercy. And according to the multitude of your mercies, blot out my iniquity. Wash me more and more from my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin. For I know my iniquity, and my sin is always before me. Against you alone have I sinned and done evil before you, so that you may be justified in your words and prevail when you are judged. For behold, I was conceived in iniquities, and my mother conceived me in sins.

For behold, you have loved truth; you have made known to me the uncertain and hidden things of your wisdom. You shall sprinkle me with hyssop, Lord, and I shall be cleansed; you shall wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow. You shall give joy and gladness to my hearing, and humbled bones shall rejoice. Turn your face away from my sins and blot out all my iniquities. Create a clean heart in me, God, and renew a right spirit within me. Do not cast me away from your face, and do not take your Holy Spirit from me. Restore to me the joy of your salvation and strengthen me with a governing spirit.

I will teach the wicked your ways, and the impious will turn to you. Deliver me from bloodshed, God, God of my salvation, and my tongue will exult in your righteousness. Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will proclaim your praise. For if you had desired sacrifice, I would certainly have given it; you will not delight in burnt offerings. A sacrifice to God is a broken spirit; a contrite and humbled heart, God, you will not despise.

Deal kindly, Lord, with Zion according to your good pleasure, so that the walls of Jerusalem may be built. Then you will accept the sacrifice of righteousness, offerings and burnt offerings; then they will place calves upon your altar.

As above. Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul, for I have sinned against you. Have mercy on me, God, have mercy on me, for my soul trusts in you. Lord, turn your face away from my sins and blot out all my iniquities. Do not remember, Lord, our ancient iniquities; let your mercies quickly anticipate us, for we have become exceedingly poor. Help us, God our Savior; for the glory of your name, Lord, deliver us and be merciful toward our sins for the sake of your name.

**Prayer.** God, ineffable name of the Trinity, whose mercies flow forth [Cod. Reg.: “Pay out your mercies to us, your ineffable name, God Trinity”], who, cleansing the cavern of the human heart from vices, make it whiter than snow: renew, we beseech you, your Holy Spirit within us, so that we may proclaim your praise; and, strengthened by a right and governing spirit, may deserve to be established in eternal dwellings in the heavenly Jerusalem. Through.

## PSALM V

(PSALM 150.) Lord, hear my prayer, and let my cry come to you. Do not turn your face away from me [Col. 0529B]; on whatever day I am troubled, incline your ear to me. On whatever day I call upon you, hear me quickly. For my days have vanished like smoke, and my bones have dried like kindling. I have been struck like grass, and my heart has dried up, because I forgot to eat my bread. Because of the voice of my groaning, my mouth has clung to my flesh.

I have become like a pelican of the wilderness; I have become like an owl in a dwelling. I kept watch and became like a solitary sparrow on the roof. All day my enemies reproached me, and those who praised me swore against me. For I ate ashes like bread and mingled my drink with weeping, because of the face of your anger and indignation; for, lifting me up, you struck me down. My days have declined like a shadow, and I have dried up like grass.

But you, Lord, remain forever, and your memorial from generation to generation. You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is the time to have mercy on her, for the time has come. For her stones have pleased your servants, and they will have pity on her dust. The nations will fear your name, Lord, and all the kings of the earth your glory. For the Lord has built Zion, and he will be seen in his glory. He has regarded the prayer of the humble and has not despised their supplication.

Let these things be written for another generation, and the people who will be created will praise the Lord, because he looked down from his holy height; the Lord looked from heaven upon the earth, to hear the groaning of the prisoners, to release the sons of the slain, to proclaim in Zion the name of the Lord [Col. 0529D] and his praise in Jerusalem, when peoples and kings gather together as one, to serve the Lord.

He answered him on the way of his strength: “Tell me the fewness of my days. Do not call me back in the middle of my days; your years endure through generations and generations. In the beginning, Lord, you founded the earth, and the heavens are the works of your hands. They will perish, but you remain; they will all grow old like a garment. You will change them like a covering, and they will be changed; but you are the same, and your years will not fail. The sons of your servants will dwell there, and their offspring will be established forever.”

As above. God, you know my foolishness, and my offenses are not hidden from you. In the multitude of your mercy hear me, in the truth of your salvation. [Col. 0530A] Hear me, Lord, for your mercy is kind; according to the multitude of your mercies, look upon me. Do not turn your face away from your servant, for I am troubled; hear me quickly. Attend to my soul and deliver it; because of my enemies, rescue me.

**Prayer.** Lord, ready to be entreated, attend to the prayer of your supplicants, so that we who have withered like grass while held in sins may be lifted up by the regard of heavenly mercy. Through.

## PSALM VI

(PSALM 129.) From the depths I cried to you, Lord; Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplication. If you observe iniquities, Lord, Lord, who will endure? For with you there is forgiveness, and because of your law I have waited for you, Lord. My soul has waited in his word; my soul has hoped in the Lord. From the morning watch until night, let Israel hope in the Lord. For with the Lord there is mercy, and abundant redemption with him. He himself will redeem Israel from all its iniquities.

As above. Lord, see my humiliation and my labor, and forgive all my sins. Do not destroy my soul with the impious, Lord, nor my life with men of blood. Redeem me, Lord, and have mercy on me.

**Prayer.** Let the ears of your compassion, Lord, we beseech you, be attentive in the prayer of your supplicants [Cod. Reg.: “Be attentive to the prayer”], for with you there is forgiveness of sins, so that you may not observe our iniquities but may bestow your mercies upon us. Through the Lord.

## PSALM VII

(PSALM 142.) Lord, hear my prayer; listen with your ears to my supplication in your truth; hear me in your righteousness. Do not enter into judgment with your servant, for no living person will be justified in your sight. For the enemy has pursued my soul; he has humbled my life to the ground. He has placed me in dark places like those who have been dead for ages, and my spirit has been anguished within me; my heart within me is troubled.

I remembered ancient days; I meditated on all your works; I meditated on the deeds of your hands. I stretched out my hands to you; my soul is like a waterless land before you. Hear me quickly, Lord; my spirit has failed. Do not turn your face away from me, lest I become like those who descend into the pit. Let me hear your mercy in the morning, for I have hoped in you. Make known to me the way in which I should walk, for I have lifted up my soul to you.

Deliver me from my enemies, Lord; I have fled to you. Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your good Spirit will lead me into a right land. For the sake of your name, Lord, you will revive me in your righteousness. In your mercy you will lead my soul out of tribulation and destroy all my enemies. You will destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.

As above. I cried to you, Lord; I said, “You are my hope, my portion in the land of the living.” Attend to my supplication, for I have been greatly humbled. Deliver me from those who persecute me, for they have grown stronger than I. Lead my soul out of prison, that I may confess your name; the righteous await me until you repay me.

**Prayer.** God, who made the joy of your sacred resurrection audible in the morning, when, returning from the underworld, you filled with joys the earth that you had left in darkness: we beseech the ineffable majesty of your power to grant that, just as you then caused the apostolic company to rejoice in the sacred resurrection [Cod. Reg.: “in the sacred resurrection”], [Col. 0531B] so you may graciously illumine this Church, which with outstretched hands implores your mercy, with the splendor of heavenly radiance. Through the Lord.

**Litany as above.**

## PRAYERS

I said, “Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul, for I have sinned against you.” God, my God, look upon me; why have you abandoned me? The words of my sins are far from my salvation. But I am a worm and not a man, a reproach of men and an outcast of the people. For you, Lord, are the one who drew me from the womb; my hope from my mother’s breasts. Upon you I was cast from the womb.

Save me from the lion’s mouth and my lowliness from the horns of the unicorns. Do not turn your face away from me; do not turn away in anger from your servant. [Col. 0531C] Be my helper; do not abandon me or despise me, God my Savior. Do not hand me over together with sinners, and do not destroy me with those who work iniquity.

Wash me more and more from my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin. For I know my iniquity, and my sin is always before me. You shall sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed; you shall wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow. Rise up, Lord, help us, and deliver us for the sake of your name.

Lord God of hosts, convert us and show us your face, and we shall be saved. Convert us, God our Savior, and turn your anger away from us. God, when you have turned toward us, you will revive us, and your people will rejoice in you. Show us, Lord, your mercy, and grant us your salvation. Lord, [Col. 0531D] hear my prayer, and let my cry come to you. Have mercy on me, God, according to your great mercy.

**Prayer.** We beseech you, almighty God, look upon the tears of your afflicted people and turn away the anger of your indignation, so that we who acknowledge the guilt of our weakness may be freed by your consolation. Through.

**Another.** God, who see that we are deprived of every strength, guard us inwardly and outwardly, so that we may be protected in body from every adversity and cleansed in mind from evil thoughts. Through.

**Another prayer.** Be merciful, Lord, toward our iniquities and ready to be entreated by your supplicants, so that, once the pardon we ask has been granted, we may glory forever in the gift of your mercy. Through.

## PRAYER FOR MONDAY, TO BE CHANTED IF SOMEONE UNDERSTANDS THAT HE HAS BEEN ABANDONED IN TRIBULATIONS

[Note: [Col. 0531D] The prayer for Monday and those that follow up to the prayer for Tuesday are absent from Cod. Reg.]

[Note: [Col. 0532D] For the sixth use, above, col. 467.]

God, who do not despise the groaning of the contrite and do not reject the feeling of those who mourn, be present to our prayers, which we presume to pour out to your compassion on account of our tribulation. We implore you to graciously receive them and grant that whatever diabolical and human adversities contrive against us, you may reduce to nothing and dash to the ground by the counsel of your compassion, so that, harmed by no adversities but rescued from every tribulation and distress, we may joyfully give thanks to you in your holy Church, through Christ our Lord.

Through him, most high God, we ask you to heed these prayers with forgiving graciousness and to look upon this prayer of ours, which we offer to you for our rescue and relief from the pressure of our weakness. Now, Lord, look upon us with a favorable face and, by your singular mercy, remove from us whatever the savagery of evils permits, whatever the wickedness of enemies inflicts, whatever the adversity of the wicked binds through their counsels, whatever threatens from judgment, whatever hangs upon a sentence, whatever is contrived by conspiracy, whatever is fabricated by accusation, whatever our own iniquities deserve, whatever is bound upon us by the fabrications of others; whatever casts us down under pressures, crushes us under torments, or confines us in distress.

Do not exercise your justice against our injustices, Lord, we beseech you; rather, manifest your compassion in our iniquities. Do not cast us down in persecution; do not destroy us through unbearable suffering, but discipline us through tribulation, raise us up through compassion, and govern us through mercy, so that, protected by you from the arrows of our enemies and delivered from our present tribulation, we may praise you, the one God in harmonious Trinity, with our voice.

You who, with your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, and the holy Spirit Paraclete, live and reign, Lord God almighty, throughout all ages of ages. Amen.

## PSALM

(PSALM 12.) How long, Lord, will you forget me forever? How long will you turn your face away from me? How long shall I place counsels in my soul and sorrow in my heart by day? How long will my enemy be exalted over me? Look upon me and hear me, Lord my God. Enlighten my eyes, lest I ever sleep in death, lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him.”

Those who afflict me will rejoice if I am shaken; but I have hoped in your mercy. My heart will exult in your salvation; I will sing to the Lord, who has given me good things, and I will sing psalms to the name of the Most High Lord.

As above. But I, in the multitude of your mercy, will enter your house; I will worship toward your holy temple in your fear. Lord, lead me in your righteousness because of my enemies; direct my way before your sight.

**Prayer.** Do not turn your face away from us, almighty God, lest our enemies be exalted against us; rather, so flood our heart with the exultation of your salvation that it may enable us to escape the sleep of the second death. Through.

## PSALM

(PSALM 70.) In you, Lord, I have hoped; let me never be put to shame. In your righteousness deliver me and rescue me. Incline your ear to me and save me. Be for me a protecting God and a fortified place, so that you may save me. For you are my strength and my refuge.

My God, rescue me from the hand of the sinner and from the hand of the lawless and unjust person. For you are my patience, Lord; Lord, my hope from my youth. Upon you I have been strengthened from the womb; from my mother’s belly you are my protector. My song is always of you; I have become like a portent to many, and you are my strong helper.

Let my mouth be filled with praise, so that I may sing your glory and your greatness all day. Do not cast me away in the time of old age; when my strength fails, do not abandon me. For my enemies have said to me, and those who guarded my soul have taken counsel together, saying: “God has abandoned him; pursue and seize him, for there is no one to rescue him.”

God, do not be far from me; my God, look to my aid. Let those who slander my soul be put to shame and fail; let those who seek evil for me be covered with shame and disgrace. But I will always hope and add to all your praise. My mouth will proclaim your righteousness and your salvation all day.

For I have not known letters [i.e., learning]; I will enter into the powers of the Lord. Lord, I will remember your righteousness alone. God, you have taught me from my youth, and until now I will proclaim your wonders. Even into old age and gray hairs, God, do not abandon me, until I proclaim your arm to every generation that is to come.

Your power and your righteousness, God, reach to the highest heights; you who have done great things, God, who is like you? How many great and evil tribulations you have shown me! Yet again you have turned and revived me, and from the depths of the earth you have brought me back once more. [Col. 0533D] You have multiplied your magnificence and, turning again, have consoled me.

For I too will confess your truth to you with the instruments of the psalm, God; I will sing to you on the lyre, Holy One of Israel. My lips will exult when I sing to you, and my soul, which you have redeemed. My tongue too will meditate on your righteousness all day, when those who seek evil for me have been put to shame and confounded.

As above. You are my refuge, Lord; from the tribulation that surrounded me, my joy, rescue me from those who surround me. Do not abandon me, Lord my God; do not depart from me. Attend to my help, Lord, my salvation.

**Prayer.** Most loving Lord, we humbly implore the immense abundance of your sweetness, so that, while we seek your truth, we may crush the swelling of accursed pride. Through.

**Another.** Eternal God, ruler of the lofty throne, who do not permit those who hope in you to be condemned to eternal shame: fill our lips, we beseech you, with your praise, and, as the instiller of good things, continually train us by these meditations. Through.

## PSALM

(PSALM 43.) We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have proclaimed to us the work that you did in their days, in ancient days. Your hand destroyed the nations and planted them; you afflicted peoples and drove them out. For they did not possess the land by their own sword, nor did their own arm save them [Col. 0534B], but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were pleased with them.

You are yourself my King and my God, who command salvations for Jacob. In you we will scatter our enemies with the horn; in your name we will despise those who rise up against us. For I will not hope in my bow, nor will my sword save me. For you saved us from those who afflicted us and put to shame those who hated us. In God we will praise all day, and in your name we will confess forever.

But now you have rejected and put us to shame, and you do not go out with our armies. You have turned us back before our enemies, and those who hate us have plundered for themselves. You have given us like sheep for food, and you have scattered us among the nations. You sold your people for nothing, and there was no multitude in their exchanges [Col. 0534C]. You made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us. You made us an illustration among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

All day my shame is before me, and the confusion of my face has covered me, at the voice of the one who reproaches and insults, at the face of the enemy and persecutor. All these things have come upon us, yet we have not forgotten you and have not acted wickedly against your covenant. Our heart has not turned back, nor have you made our paths deviate from your way. For you humbled us in a place of affliction, and the shadow of death covered us.

If we have forgotten the name of our God and stretched out our hands to a foreign god, will God not require this? For he knows the secrets of the heart. Because of you we are put to death all day; we are considered like sheep for slaughter. Rise up; why do you sleep, Lord? Rise up and do not reject us forever. Why do you turn your face away and forget our poverty and our tribulation? For our soul has been humbled in the dust; our belly has clung to the earth. Rise up, Lord, help us, and redeem us for the sake of your name.

As above. God, save me by your name. God, hear my prayer; listen with your ears to the words of my mouth.

**Prayer.** Rise up, Lord, to our aid and rescue us from the reproaches of vices. You who before our fathers conquered the kingdoms of hostile nations, deliver us from persecuting enemies by the illumination of your face. Through the Lord.

## PSALM

(PSALM 54.) Hear, God, my prayer, and do not despise my supplication; attend to me and hear me. I am saddened in my exercise, and I am troubled by the voice of the enemy and by the tribulation of the sinner. For they have turned iniquities against me, and in anger they troubled me. My heart is troubled within me, and the fear of death has fallen upon me. Fear and trembling have come upon me, and darkness has covered me.

And I said, “Who will give me wings like a dove, so that I may fly away and rest?” Behold, I have fled far away and remained in the wilderness. I awaited the one who saved me from faintness of spirit [Col. 0535B] and storm. Cast them down, Lord; divide their tongues. For I have seen iniquity and contradiction in the city. Day and night iniquity will surround it upon its walls, and labor in its midst, and justice [L.: “injustice”]. Usury and deceit have not departed from its streets.

For if my enemy had cursed me, I would certainly have endured it. And if the one who hated me had spoken great things against me, I might perhaps have hidden myself from him. But you are a man of one mind with me, my leader and my acquaintance, who together with me used to take sweet food; in the house of God we walked together in harmony.

Let death come upon them, and let them descend alive into the underworld, for wickedness is in their dwellings, in their midst. But I cried to God, and the Lord will save me. Evening, morning, and midday I will tell and proclaim, and he will hear my voice. He will redeem my soul in peace from those who draw near to me, for they were with me among many.

God will hear and humble them, he who exists before the ages. For there is no change in them, and they did not fear God. He stretched out his hand in giving. They polluted his covenant; they were divided from the anger of his face, and his heart drew near. His words were softened beyond oil, yet they themselves are darts.

Cast your care upon the Lord, and he himself will nourish you; he will not give the righteous eternal wavering. But you, God, will lead them into the pit of destruction. Men of blood and deceit will not halve their days; but I will hope in you, Lord.

[Col. 0535D] As above. But I will sing of your strength and exalt your mercy in the morning, because you have become my protector and my refuge on the day of my tribulation. My helper, I will sing psalms to you, because you are my protecting God, my God, my mercy.

**Prayer.** God, excellent champion in invisible wars, who do not permit those who confess in you to be overwhelmed by enemies: wipe away, we beseech you, the sins of tears from our eyes, so that, while we restrain carnal wars, we may deserve to please you in the light of the living. Through.

**Another.** Lord Jesus, who, remaining with the Father and the Holy Spirit before the ages and assuming human condition, were betrayed by a like-minded disciple and underwent death for the lost: hear the prayer of your supplicants, [Col. 0536A] so that, praising you in the evening, morning, and midday, we may deserve to be defended from the storms of this age. Through.

## PSALM

### (Psalm 55)

Have mercy on me, O God, for man has trampled me down; all day long he has attacked and afflicted me. My enemies have trampled me down all day long, for many are fighting against me. From the height of day I shall fear; but I shall hope in you. In God I shall praise my words; in God I have hoped. I shall not fear what flesh can do to me.

All day long they were cursing my words; all their thoughts against me were for evil. They will dwell and hide; they themselves will watch my heel. As they have lain in wait for my life, for no reason you will save them; in anger you will crush the peoples.

O God, I have declared my life to you; you have placed my tears in your sight. As also in your promise: then my enemies will turn backward. On whatever day I call upon you, behold, I know that you are my God. In God I shall praise the word; in the Lord I shall praise the utterance. In God I have hoped; I shall not fear what man can do to me.

In me are your vows, O God; I shall render praises to you. For you have rescued my soul from death and my feet from falling, so that I may please God in the light of the living.

As above. For you have tested us, O God; you have examined us by fire, as silver is examined. You brought us into a snare; you placed tribulations upon our back; you set men upon our heads. Give us, O Lord, help in tribulation; but the salvation of man is vain.

### Prayer

Remove, O Lord, the iniquity of this household, which hopes beneath the shadow of your wings, so that, once your mercy has been sent from heaven, we may be rescued from the utterly wicked pits in which we lie in ambush. Through.

### Litany as above.

In the day of my tribulation I sought God with my hands by night against him, and I was not deceived. Lord God of hosts, convert us and show us your face, and we shall be saved. Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer; listen with your ears, O God of Jacob. Our protector, look upon us, O God, and regard the face of your Christ. Will you be angry with us forever, or will you extend your anger from generation to generation? O God, when you turn, you will give us life, and your people will rejoice in you. Show us, O Lord, your mercy, and grant us your salvation.

Look upon me and have mercy on me, for I am alone and poor. The tribulations of my heart have multiplied; deliver me from my necessities. Be my helper; do not abandon me or despise me, O God my savior. But I have hoped in you, O Lord; I said, “You are my God.” In your hands are my lots. Rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from those who persecute me. Make your face shine upon your servant; save me in your mercy, O Lord; let me not be put to shame, for I have called upon you.

Do not remember, O Lord, our former iniquities; let your mercies quickly come before us, for we have become exceedingly poor.

### Prayer

Help us, O God our savior, for the glory of your name, O Lord; free us and be merciful toward our sins for the sake of your name. Forgive us our sins, O God, and grant us your mercy, sought through the supplicating address of our mouth. Regard our humility, loosen our bonds, erase our offenses, look upon our tribulation, repel adversity, and, granting the fulfillment of our petition, hear us mercifully and kindly. Through.

Almighty and everlasting God, who comes to the aid of those laboring in dangers and necessities, we humbly entreat your majesty to deign to send your holy angel, who may cherish us, laboring in our difficulties and necessities, with your consolations, by which we may both obtain help in our present tribulation and be able to grasp eternal remedies. Through.

## 73. TUESDAY: FOR MAKING SPECIAL PRAYERS

[Note: [Col. 0537D] In Martene, *On the Ancient Discipline of the Church*, p. 653.—For the second use, above, col. 466.]

Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ: you are my mercy; have mercy on me (*mihi*) [Codex Regius: *mei*, likewise “on me”]. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that I may believe in you. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that I may love you. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that I may know you. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that I may hope in you. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that my soul may live in you. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that my flesh may exult in you. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that my life [Codex Regius: “my soul”] may advance in you [Martene: “may be perfected in you”].

Have mercy, O Lord God the Father, my glory, my life. Have mercy, O Christ the Savior, my salvation, my strength. Have mercy, O Spirit the Paraclete, my consolation, my illumination. Have mercy, O Lord God, Trinity and unity. I praise you, I adore you, I confess you. My peace, my hope, my praise, my light, my beauty, my blessedness. To you be praise; to you be glory; to you be thanksgiving, always and everywhere, forever and ever.

“God, come to my aid,” three times.

## PSALM

### (Psalm 56)

[Note: [Col. 0538D] In the booklet of Charles the Bald, p. 32, without the prayers.]

Hear, O Lord, my righteousness; attend to my supplication. Listen with your ears to my prayer, which is not from deceitful lips. Let my judgment proceed from your face; let your eyes see equity. You have tested my heart and visited me by night; you examined me by fire, and no iniquity was found in me. So that my mouth may not speak the works of men, because of the words of your lips I have kept to difficult paths. Perfect my steps in your paths, so that my footprints may not be moved.

I cried out, for you heard me, O God; incline your ear to me and hear my words. Make your mercies marvelous, you who save those who hope in you. From those resisting your right hand, guard me as the apple of the eye. Beneath the shadow of your wings protect me from the face of the wicked who have afflicted me. My enemies have surrounded my soul; they have shut themselves in with their fat; their mouth has spoken pride.

They have cast me out, and now they have surrounded me; they have set their eyes on turning toward the earth. They have seized me like a lion ready for prey, and like a lion’s cub dwelling in hidden places. Arise, O Lord; anticipate him and trip him up. Rescue my soul from the wicked, your sword from the enemies of your hand.

O Lord, divide them from the few on earth during their life; their belly has been filled from your hidden things. They have been sated with sons, and they have left their remnants to their little ones. But I shall appear in righteousness before your sight; I shall be satisfied when your glory appears.

As above. I said, O Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul. Have mercy on me, O Lord, and hear my prayer. Attend to the voice of my prayer, my King and my God. For to you I shall pray, O Lord; in the morning you will hear my voice.

### Prayer

Turn the eyes of our heart, O Lord, toward perceiving the truth of your judgment, so that, while we are tested here by spiritual fire, we may forever be filled with the fruit of righteousness in your sight.

## PSALM

### (Psalm 24)

[Note: [Col. 0538D] In the same place, p. 34, without the prayers.]

To you, O Lord, I have lifted up my soul; my God, in you I trust; let me not be put to shame. Nor may my enemies mock me; indeed, all who wait for you shall not be confounded. Let all who act unjustly without cause be confounded.

Make your ways known to me, O Lord, and teach me your paths. Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and I have waited for you all day long. Remember your mercies, O Lord, and your compassion, which is from eternity. Do not remember the sins of my youth or my ignorances. According to your mercy, remember me, because of your goodness, O Lord.

The Lord is sweet and upright; therefore he will give the law to sinners on the way. He will guide the meek in judgment; he will teach the humble his ways. All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth for those who seek his covenant and his testimonies. 74 For the sake of your name, O Lord, you will be merciful toward my sin, for it is great.

Who is the person who fears the Lord? He has established a law for him on the way that he has chosen. His soul will dwell among good things, and his offspring will inherit the earth. The Lord is the strength of those who fear him, and his covenant is given so that it may be revealed to them.

My eyes are always toward the Lord, for he will draw my feet out of the snare. Look upon me and have mercy on me, for I am alone and poor. The tribulations of my heart have multiplied; deliver me from my necessities. See my humility and my labor, and forgive all my offenses. Look upon my enemies, for they have multiplied, and they hate me with unjust hatred.

Guard my soul and rescue me; let me not be put to shame, for I have hoped in you. The innocent and upright have adhered to me, because I have waited for you. O God of Israel, free him from all his iniquities.

As above. I said, “O Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul, for it has sinned against you.” Hear, O Lord, my voice with which I cried out; have mercy on me and hear me. My heart said to you, “My face has sought you”; your face, O Lord, I shall seek.

### Prayer

Deliver us from all our distresses, most gentle God, to whom we raise our souls. We ask you to forget the sins of youth and former ignorance; and if we have sinned through negligence in any way, mercifully forgive us. Through.

[Note: [Col. 0539D] In the Codex Regius, the following is found in place of this prayer: “See, we ask, O Lord, our humility, and be merciful toward our sins, for they are many; and grant that we may so mourn the past that we may avoid the present. Through.”]

## PSALM

### (Psalm 53)

[Note: [Col. 0539D] In the booklet of Charles the Bald, p. 41, without the prayer.]

O God, save me by your name, and judge me by your strength. O God, hear my prayer; listen with your ears to the words of my mouth. For strangers have risen against me, and the powerful have sought my soul; they have not set God before their eyes. For behold, God helps me, and the Lord is the protector of my soul. Turn the evils back upon my enemies, and in your truth destroy them. I will sacrifice to you freely, and I will confess your name, O Lord, for it is good. For you have rescued me from every tribulation, and my eye has looked down upon my enemies.

As above. I said, “O Lord, have mercy on me.” To you, O Lord, I shall cry; my God, do not be silent toward me, lest you ever be silent toward me and I become like those descending into the pit. Hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication when I pray to you; when I lift up my hands toward your holy temple. Make your face shine upon your servant; save me in your mercy, O Lord; let me not be put to shame, for I have called upon you.

### Prayer

Lord Jesus, who remained before the ages and, assuming the human condition, were betrayed by your single-minded disciple and underwent death for the lost: hear the prayer of those who supplicate, and grant that, praising you in the evening and at midday, we may deserve to be defended from the storms of this age—through you, our God, who live and reign with the eternal Father forever and ever. Amen.

[Note: [Col. 0539D] In the Codex Regius, with the preceding prayer omitted, this is found: “Save your Church, O Lord, trusting in the protection of your name, so that, having despised its enemies, it may magnify you with willing confession. Through.”]

## PSALM

### (Psalm 66)

[Note: [Col. 0540D] In the cited place, p. 42.]

May God have mercy on us and bless us; may he make his face shine upon us and have mercy on us. So that we may know your way on earth, your salvation among all nations. May the peoples confess you, O God; may all the peoples confess you. May the nations rejoice and exult, because you judge the peoples with equity and guide the nations on earth.

May the peoples confess you, O God; may all the peoples confess you. The earth has yielded its fruit. May God, our God, bless us; may God bless us, and may all the ends of the earth fear him.

As above. I said, “O Lord, have mercy on me.” Help us, O God our Savior; for the glory of your name, O Lord, free us. And be merciful toward our sins for the sake of your name. Let your mercy, O Lord, be upon us, just as we have hoped in you. Hear us, O God our Savior, hope of all the ends of the earth and of the distant sea.

### Prayer

Make your face shine upon us, O Lord, and bestow abundant mercy and blessing upon us. Through.

[Note: [Col. 0540D] In the same codex, in place of the preceding prayer: “Make your face shine upon us, O Lord, and bestow perpetual blessing upon us, so that, confessing you in holy fear, we may deserve to bring forth the fruit of righteousness before the face of your majesty. Through.”]

## PSALM

### (Psalm 59)

[Note: [Col. 0540D] In the cited place, p. 43.]

O God, attend to my help; O Lord, hasten to help me. Let those who seek my soul be confounded and ashamed. Let those who wish me evil turn backward and be put to shame. Let those who say to me, “Good, good!” immediately turn away in shame.

Let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you, and let those who love your salvation always say, “May the Lord be magnified.” But I am needy and poor; O God, help me. You are my helper and my deliverer; O Lord, do not delay.

As above. I said, “O Lord, have mercy on me.” O God, do not be far from me; my God, look to my aid. But I shall always hope in you, O Lord, and I shall add to all your praise. Help me, O Lord my God; save me according to your mercy.

### Prayer

Eternal God of inexhaustible help, hasten to aid your household as it supplicates (*familiae tuae supplicanti*) [Codex Regius: *familiae supplici*, “the supplicant household”], so that, once the reproaches of stains [Codex Regius: “the reproaches of evils”] have been overcome, we may always be fortified by your help.

## PSALM

### (Psalm 30)

[Note: [Col. 0540D] In the cited place, p. 37.]

In you, O Lord, I have hoped; let me not be confounded forever. In your righteousness deliver me. Incline your ear to me; hasten to rescue me. Be for me a protecting God and a house of refuge, so that you may save me. For you are my strength and my refuge; and for the sake of your name you will lead me and nourish me. You will lead me out of this snare that they hid for me, for you are my protector.

Into your hands I commend my spirit; you have redeemed me, O Lord God of truth. You hate those who vainly observe empty things. But I have hoped in the Lord; I shall exult and rejoice in your mercy, for you have regarded my humility and saved my soul from necessities. You have not shut me into the hands of the enemy; you have set my feet in a spacious place.

Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am afflicted. My eye, my soul, and my belly have been troubled in anger. For my life has failed in sorrow, and my years in groaning. My strength has been weakened in poverty, and my bones have been troubled.

I have become a reproach to all my enemies, exceedingly so to my neighbors, and a fear to my acquaintances. Those who saw me fled from me. I have been forgotten like one dead from the heart. I have become like a ruined vessel, for I heard the reproach of many who dwell around me. While they gathered together against me, they conspired to take my life.

But I have hoped in you, O Lord; I said, “You are my God.” In your hands are my lots. Rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from those who persecute me. Make your face shine upon your servant; save me in your mercy, O Lord; let me not be put to shame, for I have called upon you.

Let the wicked be ashamed and be led down into hell. Let deceitful lips, which speak iniquity against the righteous with pride and abuse, become mute. How great is the abundance of your sweetness, O Lord, which you have hidden for those who fear you! You have perfected it for those who hope in you, in the sight of the children of men.

You will hide them in the secrecy of your face from the disturbance of men. You will protect them in your tabernacle from the contradiction of tongues. Blessed is the Lord, for he has made his mercy marvelous to me in a fortified city.

But I said in the excess of my mind, “I have been cast away from the sight of your eyes.” Therefore you heard the voice of my prayer when I cried out to you. 76 Love the Lord, all his saints, for the Lord will seek truth and repay abundantly those who act proudly. Act courageously, and let your heart be strengthened, all who hope in the Lord.

As above. I said, “O Lord, have mercy on me.” Hear, O God, my prayer, and do not despise my supplication; attend to me and hear me. O Lord, hear my prayer, and let my cry come to you. On whatever day I call upon you, hear me quickly.

### Prayer

Immense ruler of the lofty throne [Codex Regius: “eternal ruler”], who do not permit those who hope in you to be condemned to eternal shame, fill, we ask, our lips [with your praise], and always exercise us in these meditations on good things [Codex Regius: “deign to exercise us”]. Through.

## PSALM

### (Psalm 85)

[Note: [Col. 0541D] In the cited place, p. 44.]

Incline your ear, O Lord, and hear me, for I am needy and poor. Guard my soul, for I am holy; save your servant, my God, who hopes in you. Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I have cried to you all day long. Gladden the soul of your servant, for to you, O Lord, I have lifted up my soul.

For you, O Lord, are gentle and mild, and rich in mercy toward all who call upon you. Listen with your ears, O Lord, to my prayer; attend to the voice of my supplication. In the day of my tribulation I cried to you, for you heard me.

There is none like you among the gods, O Lord, and there are no works like yours. All the nations that you made will come and worship before you, O Lord, and they will glorify your name. For you are great and do marvelous things; you alone are God.

Lead me, O Lord, in your way, and I shall walk in your truth. Let my heart rejoice, so that it may fear your name. I shall confess you, O Lord my God, with all my heart, and I shall glorify your name forever. For your mercy is great toward me, and you have rescued my soul from the lower hell.

O God, the unjust have risen against me, and the assembly of the powerful has sought my soul; they have not set you before their eyes. But you, O Lord God, are compassionate and merciful, patient and rich in mercy, and true.

Look upon me and have mercy on me; give your authority to your servant, and save the son of your handmaid. Establish with me a sign for good, so that those who hate me may see it and be confounded, because you, O Lord, have helped me and consoled me.

As above. I said, “O Lord, have mercy on me.” Do not abandon me, O Lord my God; do not depart from me. Attend to my help, O Lord, God of my salvation. You are my helper and my protector, my God; do not delay.

### Prayer

Gladden, O Lord, the face of your family [Codex Regius: “your face over your family”], and rescue our souls from the lower hell, so that, protected by contemplation of your face, we may trample the desires of the flesh under spiritual rule. Through.

### Litany as above.

I said, “O Lord my God, I have hoped in you.” Save me from all who persecute me and free me. Lest he seize my soul like a lion, while there is no one to redeem or save. But you, O Lord, do not distance your help from me; look toward my defense.

Judge, O Lord, those who harm me; fight against those who attack me. Take up arms and shield, and arise to help me. Draw out the sword and close ranks against those who persecute me; say to my soul, “I am your salvation.”

O Lord, turn your face away from my sins, and erase all my iniquities. Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me. Do not cast me away from your face, and do not take your Holy Spirit from me. Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and strengthen me with a governing spirit.

Rescue me, O Lord, from the evil man; deliver me from the unjust man. Do not hand me over, O Lord, to the sinner’s desire; they have plotted against me. Do not abandon me, lest they perhaps be exalted.

O Lord, I cried to you; hear me; attend to my voice when I cry to you. Let my prayer be directed like incense in your sight; the lifting of my hands like an evening sacrifice. Set, O Lord, a guard over my mouth and a door of restraint around my lips. Do not incline my heart toward words of malice, to make excuses for sins.

O Lord, hear my prayer; listen with your ears to my supplication in your truth; hear me in your righteousness. Do not enter into judgment with your servant, for no living person will be justified in your sight.

Make your mercy known to me in the morning, for I have hoped in you. Make known to me the way in which I should walk, for I have lifted up my soul to you. Rescue me from my enemies, O Lord; I have fled to you. Teach me to do your will, for you are my God.

Your good Spirit will lead me into a straight land. For the sake of your name, O Lord, you will give me life in your righteousness. You will lead my soul out of tribulation, and in your mercy you will destroy my enemies. You will destroy all who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.

O Lord, hear my prayer, and let my cry come to you. Have mercy on me, O God, according to your great [mercy], etc.

[Note: [Col. 0543D] The Codex Regius ends here.]

## PRAYER OF SAINT AUGUSTINE

To you alone, O Lord, have I sinned, because no human being is without sin; and therefore to you alone have I sinned, because you alone are without sin. Give mercy, O Lord, to the wretched man whom you have spared for so long in his criminality. Look upon the unhappy man, O immeasurable pity. Regard the cruel man, O universal mercy.

Almost in despair, I come to the Almighty; wounded, I run to the physician. Preserve the gentleness of your compassion, you who have suspended the sword of vengeance for so long. Erase the multitude of crimes by the multitude of your mercies. . . . Here some things are missing.

And I cried to you, O Lord, and in the morning my prayer will come before you. Why, O Lord, do you reject my prayer and turn your face away from me? I am poor and have been in labors from my youth; but, having been exalted, I was humbled and troubled. Your anger has passed over me; your terrors have troubled me. They surrounded me like water all day long; they surrounded me together. You have put far from me friend and neighbor, and my acquaintances because of misery.

### Prayer

Redeemer of all and ineffable Savior God, who, penetrating the regions below for our sake, became free among the dead: hear the morning prayer. Have mercy, O Lord, on your family, and rescue us from the most wicked slavery of the enemy lying in wait. Through.

### Another Prayer

God, palm of all blessedness, who wisely provide and form your faithful so that they may walk in your law, search your testimonies, and keep your commandments: grant us to seek your ordinances with all our heart, to understand your utterances, and to proclaim your marvels, so that we who until now have wandered like lost sheep may rejoice that, restored by your loving shoulders, we have been returned to paradise. Through.

### Litany as above.

O God, be merciful to me, a sinner. O Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul, for I have sinned against you. For my loins are filled with delusions, and there is no soundness in my flesh. For the sake of your name, O Lord, you will be merciful toward my sin, for it is great.

Who understands his sins? Cleanse me from my hidden faults, and spare your servant from those of others. Do not remember the sins of my youth or my ignorances. According to your mercy, remember me, because of your goodness, O Lord. Have mercy on me, O God, according to your great mercy; erase my iniquity.

## METRICAL PRAYER OF AURELIUS PRUDENTIUS CLEMENS

O all-powerful God, giver of the soul, O Christ God,

from whose mouth one Spirit, God, proceeds,

under your direction I am ruled; with you as my prince I lead my life.

With you as judge I tremble, pale with fear;

yet with you as the same judge I take hope that whatever I do

and say, however unworthy of pardon, may be pardonable before you.

I confess; willingly forgive and spare the one who confesses.

I have deserved every evil; but you, good judge, take away

what I have deserved; in your favor bestow better things upon the one who prays.

Grant to my soul, when one day it has left

the lodging of this body, built for itself from sinews, skin, blood, and gall,

which, as a corrupt inhabitant, it alas

cherishes and embraces too much in luxury—when the mournful hour

has closed these eyes and the body has been laid out and proclaimed dead,

and the mind, stripped bare, enjoys its own sight.

Let it not see some savage one from the race of robbers,

merciless, raging, threatening in face and voice,

terrible, who, like a marauder, may drag me, stained

by the sprinkling of my habits, headlong,

and plunge me as I fall into black caverns,

to exact every last quarter of a penny owed

for a life that has brought ruin.

There are many dwellings in the treasures of the Father, O Christ,

hidden in differing places. I do not ask for a house

in the blessed region; let there be there the camps of men—

the hosts who, scorning dusty wealth,

sought your riches. Let virginity, white with unfading blossom,

be there, its spirit cut off and castrated.

But for me it is enough if no face of a Tartarean minister

meets me, nor the greedy flame of Gehenna

devours this soul, plunged into the deepest furnaces.

May I be in cavernous Avernus; for, because of bodily stain, it is necessary

that sorrowful fire swallow me.

Then let the slow fires breathe out their soothing vapors,

and let their heat grow warm with languishing warmth.

Let immense light glorify others, and foreheads encircled with crowns;

let a light punishment mercifully burn me.

## Further Prayers Concerning the Gift of Charity

I shall love you, O Lord, my strength.

## Concerning the Praise of God

I shall bless the Lord at all times; his praise will always be in my mouth.

## For Faith

O Lord, increase our faith.

## For Hope

Hear us, O God our Savior, hope of all the ends of the earth.

## For God’s Protection

Guard me, O Lord, as the apple of the eye; beneath the shadow of your wings protect us.

## For Conversion

O Lord, let me go, so that I may be refreshed before I depart and be no more.

## For Strength

I shall keep my strength toward you, because you are God my protector; my God’s mercy will come before me.

## For the Grace of God

Your mercy will come before me, and your mercy will follow me all the days of my life.

## For the Final Day

For you are my protector, O Lord; into your hands I shall commend my spirit.

## For Temptation

Rescue my soul, O Lord, from the sword, and my only one from the hand of the dog.

O Lord, free my soul; the Lord is merciful and just, and our God has mercy.

## For the Vision of God

One thing I asked of the Lord; this I shall seek: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to see the will [L.: “delight”] of the Lord and visit his temple. Blessed are those who dwell in your house, O Lord; forever and ever they shall praise you.

## PRAYER OF ALCUIN

### On Knowledge of God, Forgiveness of Sins, and Rescue from Various Tribulations

[Note: [Col. 0545D] Martene, in the cited place, p. 653.]

Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ: you are my mercy, have mercy on me. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that I may ask you rightly. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may make me worthy to be heard. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may hear me. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may teach me your holy will.

Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may nourish me in your charity. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may illuminate me with your Holy Spirit. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that I may believe in you. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that I may know you. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that I may love you. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that I may hope in you.

Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may rescue me from eternal death. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may grant me true repentance for all my sins. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may grant me remission of all my sins. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may rescue me from every tribulation.

Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may free me from every impurity of heart and body. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may extinguish in me the fountain of lust. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may free me from the snares of the devil. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may free me from every evil. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that you may free me from impure thought.

Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that my soul may live in you. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that my flesh may exult in you. Have mercy, O Lord; have mercy, O Christ, so that my life may advance in you. Have mercy, O Lord God the Father, my glory, my life. Have mercy, O Christ the Savior, my salvation, my strength. Have mercy, O Spirit the Paraclete, my consolation, my illumination.

Have mercy, O Lord God, Trinity and unity. I praise you, I adore you, I confess you: my peace, my hope, my praise, my light, my beauty, my blessedness. To you be praise; to you be glory; to you be thanksgiving, always and everywhere, forever and ever.

## WEDNESDAY. PRAYER OF BLESSED AMBROSE

### In Which He Asks Forgiveness for His Sins

Compassionate and merciful, patient and greatly merciful, great and terrible God: I confess my sins to you; I disclose my wounds to you. Because of your ineffable goodness, bring medicine to me, a wretched man.

For you, most gentle one, have deigned to say: “I do not desire the death of the sinner, but that he should be converted and live.” I confess: I have acted wickedly; my way is perverse in your sight. My life has fallen into a pit of misery; my soul has been extinguished in iniquities.

Pride, lust, anger, impatience, malice, envy, gluttony, drunkenness, desire, robbery, lying, perjury, vulgarity, foolish speech, ignorance, negligence, and other such plagues have killed my soul. My heart and my lips have been polluted; my sight and hearing, my taste, smell, and touch have been polluted. In every way—in thought, word, and deed—I have been ruined.

I beseech you, Lord God, whose mercy has no end: draw me as you drew the sinful woman. Grant me, as you granted her, never to cease kissing your feet, bathing them with tears, and wiping them with my hair. Grant that, in proportion to the greatness of my iniquities, my love for you may be great, so that because of your immense compassion you may forgive me everything.

Grant me forgiveness for the past, self-restraint concerning present evils, and caution concerning the future. Make me attain your mercy in its fullness before I die, and do not allow my days to end before you forgive my sins; but, as you will and as you know, have mercy on me.

## PSALMS TO BE SUNG FOR ANY TRIBULATION

## PSALM

### (Psalm 21)

[Note: [Col. 0546D] For the fourth use, above, col. 467.]

My God, my God, look upon me; why have you abandoned me? The words of my sins are far from my salvation. My God, I shall cry out by day, and you will not hear; and by night, yet not for foolishness to me. But you dwell in the holy place, the praise of Israel.

In you our fathers hoped; they hoped, and you delivered them. They cried to you and were saved; they hoped in you and were not confounded. But I am a worm and not a man, the reproach of men and the outcast of the people. All who saw me mocked me; they spoke with their lips and shook their heads.

“He hoped in the Lord; let him rescue him; let him save him, since he desires him.” For you are the one who drew me from the womb; my hope from my mother’s breasts. Upon you I was cast from the womb; from my mother’s womb you are my God. Do not depart from me, for tribulation is near, and there is no one to help.

Many calves surrounded me; fat bulls besieged me. They opened their mouths against me like a lion ravaging and roaring. I have been poured out like water, and all my bones have been scattered. My heart has become like melting wax in the midst of my belly. My strength has dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue has clung to my jaws; you have led me into the dust of death.

For many dogs have surrounded me; the assembly of the wicked has besieged me. They have pierced my hands and my feet, and they have counted all my bones. They themselves looked upon me and observed me; they divided my garments among themselves and cast lots for my clothing.

But you, O Lord, do not distance your help from me; look toward my defense. Rescue my soul from the sword, and my only one from the hand of the dog. Save me from the lion’s mouth, and my humility from the horns of the unicorns.

I shall declare your name to my brothers; in the midst of the Church I shall praise you. You who fear the Lord, praise him; glorify him, all the offspring of Jacob. Let all the offspring of Israel fear him, for he has not despised or scorned the supplication of the poor.

Nor has he turned his face away from me; and when I cried to him, he heard me. With you is my praise in the great Church; I shall fulfill my vows in the sight of those who fear him. The poor shall eat and be filled, and those who seek him shall praise the Lord; their hearts shall live forever and ever.

All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the Lord. All the families of the nations shall worship in his sight. For the kingdom belongs to the Lord, and he himself shall rule the nations. All the prosperous of the earth have eaten and worshiped; in his sight all who descend into the earth shall fall.

And my soul shall live for him, and my offspring shall serve him. The coming generation shall be announced to the Lord, and they shall announce his righteousness to the people who will be born, whom the Lord has made.

As above. O Lord, how many are those who afflict me? Many rise up against me. Many say to my soul, “There is no covenant for him in his God” [Alternative: “There is no salvation for him in his God”]. But you, O Lord, are my protector, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

## Prayer

God, head of mercy, who for our sake descended into the womb, were fastened to the wood, pierced by a nail, and, with your garments moreover divided by lot, rose free from the underworld: we beseech you not to be unmindful of this holy exchange, O deliverer of the people from the enemy lion, who were once the liberator of the fathers who hoped in you. Through the Lord.

## Psalm

### (Psalm 63)

Hear, O God, my prayer when I plead; from fear of the enemy deliver my soul. You have protected me from the assembly of the wicked, from the multitude of those who practice iniquity. For they sharpened their tongues like a sword; they bent their bow—a bitter thing—to shoot the blameless in secret. Suddenly they will shoot at him and will not fear; they have strengthened for themselves an evil speech. They recounted their plans in order to conceal snares; they said, “Who will see them?” They searched out iniquities; they failed while searching with scrutiny. A man will approach the deep heart, and God will be exalted. The arrows of children have become their wounds, and their tongues have been weakened against them. All who saw them were troubled, and every person was afraid. And they proclaimed the works of God and understood his deeds. He will rejoice in the Lord and hope in him, and all upright in heart will be praised.

As above. A helper in times of opportunity, in tribulations that have found us exceedingly. Let all who know your name hope in you, Lord, for you have not abandoned those who seek you, Lord. God, who sits upon the throne and judges equity, be a refuge for the poor, because you alone consider labor and sorrow.

## Prayer

God, guardian of all believers, protect your Church from the assembly of the wicked, who strive to attack it with hidden arrows, so that, retaining you with a sound and upright understanding, it may rejoice perpetually in the merits of the just.

## Psalm

### (Psalm 78)

Save me, O God, for the waters have entered even to my soul. I am stuck in the mire of the deep, and there is no firm ground. I have come into the depths of the sea, and the storm has submerged me. I have labored crying out; my throat has become hoarse. My eyes have failed while I hope in my God. Those who hate me without cause have multiplied beyond the hairs of my head. My enemies, who persecuted me unjustly, have grown strong; what I did not seize, then I had to repay.

God, you know my foolishness, and my offenses are not hidden from you. Let those who await you, Lord of hosts, not be put to shame because of me. Let those who seek you, God of Israel, not be confounded because of me. For on your account I endured reproach; shame covered my face. I became a stranger to my brothers and an alien to the sons of my mother. For zeal for your house consumed me, and the reproaches of those who reproached you fell upon me. I covered my soul in fasting, and it became a reproach to me. I made my garment sackcloth, and I became a byword to them. Those who sat at the gate spoke against me, and those who drank wine sang mockingly about me.

But I direct my prayer to you, Lord: it is the time of favor, O God. In the abundance of your mercy hear me, in the truth of your salvation. Deliver me from the mire, so that I may not become stuck; free me from those who hate me and from the depths of the waters. May the storm of the water not overwhelm me, nor the deep swallow me; may the pit not close its mouth over me. Hear me, Lord, for your mercy is kind; according to the abundance of your compassion look upon me. Do not turn your face away from your servant, for I am afflicted; hear me quickly. Attend to my soul and deliver it; because of my enemies rescue me.

You know my reproach, my shame, and my reverence. All those who afflict me are before you. My heart awaited reproach and misery; I looked for someone who would grieve together with me, but there was none, and for someone who would comfort me, but I found none. They gave gall as my food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

Let their table before them become a snare, and a retribution and a stumbling-block. Let their eyes be darkened, so that they may not see, and always make their back bend. Pour out your anger upon them, and let the fury of your wrath seize them. Let their dwelling become desolate, and let there be no one inhabiting their tents. For they persecuted the one whom you struck, and they added to the pain of my wounds. Add iniquity upon their iniquity, and let them not enter into your righteousness. Let them be wiped from the book of the living, and let them not be written with the righteous.

I am poor and sorrowful; your salvation, O God, has received me. I will praise the name of God with a song and magnify him with praise. And it will please God more than a young bull, producing horns and hooves. Let the poor see and rejoice; seek God, and your soul will live. For the Lord has heard the poor and has not despised his prisoners. Let heaven and earth praise him, the sea and all that creeps in them. For God will save Zion, and the cities of Judah will be built. They will inhabit it and acquire it as an inheritance. The offspring of his servants will possess it, and those who love his name will dwell in it.

As above. In tribulation I called upon the Lord, and I cried out to my God. And he heard my voice from his holy temple, and my cry entered his ears in his presence. Our God is refuge and strength, a helper in tribulations that have found us exceedingly.

## Prayer

Most gracious Lord, hear us in the truth of your salvation, so that, rescued from the filth of sin, we may deserve to be inscribed in the book of life by a heavenly finger. Through.

You will lead my soul out of tribulation, and you will destroy all who afflict my soul. Hear, O God, my prayer when I plead.

## Prayer of Saint Ambrose

### [Col. 0549D]

Christ, supreme power of God, one and undivided majesty, the whole substance of my prayer, I invoke your holy name. Hear me as, within my own heart, I struggle with myself, acknowledging the sins of my deeds and confessing the crimes of my thoughts.

Break, Lord, the devil’s arts; for by suggesting something else with his lips, he ensnares the prayer itself. Look upon the tears of me, your suppliant; and when there are no tears, pour into me the tenderness of your mercy. Preserve in me an unstained faith, and reconcile me always in peace with my neighbors. Distribute the fruits of your bread [F.: “your fruit”] [lacuna] with your own generosity. To you I bow my neck; to you I bend my knees. Although you are one, I confess you as Lord and God in the holy Trinity. Break, Lord, the powers of my enemies against me; rescue me from dangers, protect me in every matter, and defend me against accusation. Though I lie sick, grant as completed those things that I cannot accomplish, as though they had been completed.

## Prayer

For our relatives and all the faithful departed.

You, holy Father, almighty and eternal God, we humbly beseech concerning the spirits of your male and female servants whom, from the beginning of this world, you commanded to be summoned to you: deign, Lord, to give them a bright place, a place of refreshment and rest; and grant that they may pass through the gates of hell and the ways of darkness, and remain in the dwelling-places of the saints and in the holy light that you once promised to Abraham and his seed. Let their souls suffer no injury; but when that great day of resurrection and recompense has come, deign, Lord, to raise them together with your saints and elect. Wipe away their offenses and sins, even to the last farthing, and grant that with you they may obtain the life of immortality and the eternal kingdom.

As above. Do not hand them over to the beasts. Eternal rest. The souls of the righteous.

## Psalm

### (Psalm 5)

Give ear, Lord, to my words; understand my cry. Attend to the voice of my prayer, my King and my God. For to you I will worship, Lord; in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will stand before you and will see, for you are not a God who desires iniquity. The wicked will not dwell near you, nor will the unjust remain before your eyes. You hate all who practice iniquity; you will destroy all who speak falsehood. The Lord will abominate a man of blood and deceit.

But I, in the abundance of your mercy, will enter your house; I will worship toward your holy temple in your fear. Lord, lead me in your righteousness; because of my enemies direct my way before you. For there is no truth in their mouth; their heart is vain. Their throat is an open grave; they acted deceitfully with their tongues. Judge them, O God. Let them fall away from their schemes; according to the multitude of their ungodliness drive them out, for they have provoked you, Lord.

And let all who hope in you rejoice; forever they will exult, and you will dwell in them. All who love your name will glory in you, for you will bless the righteous. Lord, you have crowned us with the shield of your good will.

As above. From the gate of hell. Precious in the sight of the Lord.

## Prayer

Merciful Lord, who understand the groaning of a contrite heart before it is uttered, make us, I ask, a temple of the Paraclete, so that we may deserve to be crowned with the shield of heavenly benevolence. Through.

## Another Prayer

We beseech you, Lord, mercifully incline the ears of your kindness to the supplications of our cry, so that the souls of your male and female servants and of all Christians, freed from every contagion of death, may deserve to enjoy the heavenly kingdom. Through you, Christ Jesus, who live and reign.

## Psalm

### (Psalm 6)

Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger, nor correct me in your wrath. Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak; heal me, Lord, for my bones are troubled. And my soul is greatly troubled; but you, Lord—how long? Turn, Lord, and rescue my soul; save me for the sake of your mercy. For there is no one in death who remembers you; but in hell, who will confess to you?

I have labored in my groaning; every night I will wash my bed; I will water my couch with my tears. My eye has been troubled by anger; I have grown old among all my enemies. Depart from me, all who practice iniquity, for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping. The Lord has heard my supplication; the Lord has received my prayer. Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled; let them turn back and be exceedingly quickly ashamed.

As above. The righteous will be in everlasting remembrance. Their souls will dwell amid good things.

## Prayer

We beseech you, Lord, that you not rebuke the souls of your servants in your fury and anger; but, cleansed from every stain of sin, grant them a place of refreshment through the gift of your mercy. Through the Lord.

## Psalm

### (Psalm 39)

With expectation I awaited the Lord, and he inclined toward me. He heard my prayers and brought me up from the pit of misery and from the mire of filth. He set my feet upon a rock and directed my steps. He put a new song into my mouth, a hymn to our God. Many will see and fear, and they will hope in the Lord.

Blessed is the man whose hope is the name of the Lord, who has not turned toward vanities and false insanities. You have done many wonders, Lord my God, and in your thoughts there is no one like you. I proclaimed and spoke; they have multiplied beyond number. You did not desire sacrifice and offering, but you perfected ears for me. You did not ask for a burnt offering or for sin; then I said, “Behold, I come. At the beginning of the book it is written concerning me that I should do your will; my God, I have desired it, and your law is in the midst of my heart.”

I proclaimed your righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I will not restrain my lips, Lord, you know it. I did not hide your righteousness in my heart; I declared your truth and your salvation. I did not conceal your mercy and your truth from the great assembly. But you, Lord, do not keep your mercies far from me; your mercy and your truth have always received me.

For evils without number have surrounded me; my iniquities have seized me, and I could not see. They have multiplied beyond the hairs of my head, and my heart has abandoned me. Be pleased, Lord, to rescue me; Lord, look upon me to help me. Let those who seek my soul in order to take it be confounded and put to shame together. Let those who wish me harm turn back and be put to shame. Let those who say to me, “Good, good,” immediately bear their shame.

Let all who seek you exult and rejoice in you, and let those who love your salvation always say, “The Lord be magnified.” But I am a beggar and poor; the Lord is concerned for me. You are my helper and protector; my God, do not delay.

As above. Arise, Lord, into your rest. The righteous will live forever.

## Prayer

May the souls of your servants, Lord, obtain a share in the blessed resurrection and deserve to possess eternal life in heaven, through you, Christ Jesus, who live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, through immortal ages of ages. Amen.

## Another Prayer

God, the unique expectation of your servants, whom the heading of the principal book teaches will come into the world: we beseech you, implant your law in the midst of our heart, so that, proclaiming your [lacuna], we may be rescued from the dangers that threaten. Through.

## Prayer for Any Deceased Person

Almighty and merciful God, we beseech your clemency, because by your judgment we are both born and brought to an end: receive into eternal rest the soul of our brother, whom your mercy commanded to pass from the habitation of this world, and permit him to be joined with your elect in the resurrection, so that in eternal blessedness he may remain with them without end. Through.

Receive, Lord, the soul whom you redeemed with your servants; and let the one who confessed you in the common life be established by you in everlasting life.

## Another Prayer

Deliver, Lord, the soul of your servant from the dangers of hell, from the dangers of darkness, from many persecutions, and from the fires of the flames of Gehenna. Deliver, Lord, the soul of your servant, as you delivered Abraham from Ur of the Chaldeans. Deliver, Lord, the soul of your servant, as you delivered Lot from the city of the Sodomites. Deliver, Lord, the soul of your servant, as you delivered the people of Israel from the hand of the Egyptians. Deliver, Lord, the soul of your servant, as you delivered Moses from the hand of Pharaoh, who was leading the people of Israel in the desert.

Deliver, Lord, the soul of your servant, as you delivered David from the hand of Saul and from the hand of the giant Goliath. Deliver, Lord, the soul of your servant, as you delivered Elijah and Enoch from this world. Deliver, Lord, the soul of your servant, as you delivered the three young men from the furnace of blazing fire. Deliver, Lord, the soul of your servant, as you delivered Susanna from the hand of the rulers. Deliver, Lord, the soul of your servant, as you delivered Daniel from the lions’ den. As you delivered, Lord, Jonah from the belly of the whale, so deign to deliver the soul of our brother from all dangers of punishments and command that it enjoy eternal goods with your elect. Through.
